methods_quotes.q: The TDSHS laboratory tested an aliquot from this can using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for botulinum toxin and did not detect toxin.
CDC re-rinsed the two cans and tested the rinse water for botulinum toxin by mouse bioassay
Mouse bioassay results were consistent with ELISA findings.
